user.title: Your own Claude for Even AI
user.description:
Paste your Anthropic API key. It is kept on this Home Assistant server and used only to ask Claude.

{waiting}

connect.title: Point Even AI at it
connect.description:
In the Even app, open **Settings > Even AI > Agent Configuration**, enter these two, and tap **Save & Activate**.

**Endpoint**

`{endpoint}`

**API Key**

`{token}`

Both are shown again under **Configure** whenever you need them. Press Submit to finish.

reconfigure.title: Replace the Anthropic key
reconfigure.description: Paste the new Anthropic API key. Everything else stays as it is, including the keys the Even app, the session app and the laptop use.

error.invalid_auth: Anthropic did not accept that key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Anthropic. Check this server's internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This is already set up. Open it under Devices & services to change it.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new key is in use.

data.followup_minutes: Start a new chat after this long without a question
data.laptop: Let the glasses run jobs on my laptop
data.new_even_key: Make a new Even AI key

data_description.profile: What you want Claude to know from the start: who you are, what you study or work on, the people and things that come up, how you like answers. It goes to Claude with every question.
data_description.followup_minutes: A question within this many minutes of the last one carries on the same chat; anything later starts fresh. Claude is told how long ago the last one was, and leaves an earlier topic alone when a question does not follow on from it. Saying "new chat" starts fresh at any time.
data_description.notes: One per line. Delete a line to make it forget that, or add one. "(until 2026-12-01)" at the end of a line makes it forget that note after that day.
data_description.stt_provider: What turns your voice into text in the Claude session app on the glasses. The names in your profile are passed along, so they come out spelled right.
data_description.stt_key: The API key for that service, such as a Groq key from console.groq.com > API Keys. Kept on this server.
data_description.dayflow_url: Optional. The relay address from DayFlow's live link (it ends in /relay), so Claude can answer about your day. Only your school timetable, your own tasks and your phone calendar are read from it; nothing else in DayFlow is.
data_description.dayflow_secret: The live link's secret. Kept on this server.
data_description.laptop: Claude Code on the laptop does what you ask without checking first. Turn this off to stop it straight away: a job that is running is called off, and any waiting are dropped.
data_description.notify: The phone with the Home Assistant app. Until you save a choice here, the first phone listed is used. Let the Even app show its notifications to see them on the glasses.
data_description.new_even_key: Only if the key shown above may have got out. The old one stops working at once; put the new one in the Even app and the session app.
data_description.new_laptop_key: Only if the laptop key shown above may have got out. The old one stops working at once; run the helper's setup on the laptop again with the new one.
data_description.model: Automatic starts quick questions on Haiku, which is quick and about a twentieth of the price, and hands anything that needs careful thought, the web or your laptop to Sonnet. Sessions use Sonnet, and Opus when you ask it to think hard. Laptop jobs get the model each one needs. Pick a model to use only that one.
